messages:
kyle: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's GPU-pool OOM incident. We need concrete runbook edits: clearer triage steps, explicit commands, and an escalation path if we hit sustained OOMs. Assigning owners in-thread so we can close items by next sprint.
maya: +1. Can you list the exact commands you ran so we can put them into the runbook? Also we should add a quick health check users can run before paging.
kyle: Commands I used in order: `nvidia-smi -q`, `docker ps --filter "status=running" --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'`, `ps aux | grep -i llama`, `curl -s http://localhost:8000/metrics | jq '.kv_cache_size'`, and our eviction helper `./tools/evict_kv_prefix.sh --prefix=model-A --dry-run`.
priya: I'll own adding the commands and a short explanation of when to run them. ETA: EOW Friday. I'll include expected outputs to help triage (e.g., what a saturated KV cache looks like).
sam: I'll add a healthcheck snippet to the runbook: `curl -sS http://$INSTANCE/health | grep -E "(ok|degraded)"` and a `curl -sS http://$INSTANCE/metrics | jq '{tokens: .tokens_per_sec, kv: .kv_cache_size}'` example. Also propose a quick `top` snapshot command to capture memory per process.
maya: Escalation path proposal: If triage (steps 1-4) doesn't restore throughput within 10 minutes, page capacity-oncall and @maya; if degraded >30 minutes escalate to infra-leads and open a capacity-surge ticket. Add explicit SRE pager targets and what to include in the page (pod logs, `kubectl top`, eviction command results).
kyle: Agreed. Add fallback model routing step too: `rbctl route set --model=redwood-vicuna-7b-quant --weight=0.2` as a temporary mitigation to reduce memory pressure. Put it under "fallbacks" with exact rollback steps.
oncall-bot: NOTE: Recorded incident 2026-03-23T15:12Z. Pager duty runbook link: <https://internal.runbooks/redwood/cache-oom>. Please update runbook tags.
priya: Also spotted a recurring pattern: minor KV growth every Tuesday when batch jobs run. Add a scheduled eviction job suggestion and a checklist to verify KV TTLs after deploys. I'll add a monitoring alert threshold: kv_cache_size > 85% for 10m -> runbook step 2.
kyle: Owners: priya -> runbook commands + monitoring thresholds; sam -> quick healthcheck snippet and example captures; maya -> escalation path text and pager targets; kyle -> fallback routing commands + rollback. Due dates: priya 2026-03-27, sam 2026-03-26, maya 2026-03-25, kyle 2026-03-24. I'll create PRs and ping the channel when ready.
maya: I'll also add a tiny troubleshooting card: "If eviction script fails with EBUSY, check kernel OOM logs and restart the serving process in place (graceful restart steps included)." Keep it short.
sam: Added a short template for postmortem followups to the runbook: Owner, ETA, Validation steps, and Link to related incidents. That should make followups easier.
kyle: Thanks team. Action items summarized in PR checklist format will be great. I'll open a meta-issue to track completion and link PRs. If anyone needs to reprioritize, reply here. :thumbsup:
